title: Sex-Linked Inheritance Pattern
text: Males have XY chromosomes. They inherit X from mother and Y from father. Since haemophilia is on the X chromosome, males only need one copy of the recessive allele to be affected.

title: Mother's Contribution
text: The carrier mother (X^H X^h) can pass either X^H (normal) or X^h (haemophilia allele) to her sons. Each has a 50% chance.
